note: M5 art batch for gen-art.mjs. Original designs only: no franchise names, logos or emblems in any prompt.
style: painterly digital illustration, muted wasteland palette of dusty ochre, rust and faded teal, soft film grain, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark

key.prompt: A wide painted vista of a ruined desert highway at golden hour, a collapsed roadside gas station silhouetted against a huge low sun, rusted car husks along a cracked road, dust haze, dramatic layered clouds, broken signposts without any writing, empty open ground on the left third of the frame, cinematic matte painting, no people

A hopeful painted wasteland sunrise: warm light spreading across cracked ground and a ruined city skyline, a patched cloth banner on a pole planted atop a heap of scrap metal in the foreground, a small cooking fire with rising smoke, clearing sky, cinematic matte painting, no people

A grim painted wasteland dusk: smouldering wreckage and a toppled scrap barricade on a darkening plain, heavy storm clouds with a sullen red glow on the horizon, drifting ash, abandoned equipment crates, a lone broken lantern on the ground, cinematic matte painting, no people

portrait.editPrompt: Same character, head and shoulders portrait, painted, muted wasteland palette, plain dark background
portrait.textTemplate: A head and shoulders character portrait of {desc}. Mildly stylized heroic proportions, detailed, not cute, painted, muted wasteland palette, plain dark background, no text, no logos

textUnits.knight: a disciplined armoured soldier in a battered steel-plated combat harness and a closed visor helmet with a plain unmarked front, grim and professional
textUnits.initiate: a young recruit in a padded grey tunic with mismatched scavenged shoulder plates and a rolled cloth cap, nervous but determined, short hair
textUnits.paladin: a veteran heavy warrior in massive rust-red and grey riveted powered plate armour, a round sealed helmet with a narrow glowing visor slit, commanding presence
textUnits.field-scribe: a scholarly field technician in a hooded dark-red robe over a canvas work vest, round brass goggles, ink-stained fingers, a satchel strap across the chest
textUnits.machine-gun-turret-mk1: a squat automated machine gun turret on a sturdy tripod, riveted gunmetal housing, a single small amber sensor lens, an ammunition belt feeding in from a box
